description: This file defines the CalendarSyncService class responsible for synchronizing calendar events, including handling event processing, cancellations, and rescheduling bookings, with detailed logging and metrics.

classes.name: CalendarSyncService
classes.description: Service class for synchronizing calendar events, handling cancellations and rescheduling, with dependency injection for booking repository.

methods.name: handleEvents
methods.description: Processes a list of calendar subscription events, filtering for cal.com events, and dispatching to cancel or reschedule bookings accordingly.

methods.name: cancelBooking
methods.description: Cancels a booking based on a calendar event, verifying booking existence and ownership, then invoking handleCancelBooking.

methods.name: rescheduleBooking
methods.description: Reschedules a booking if the start time has changed, dynamically importing booking service, and creating a new booking with updated data.
